name: Cocoa shell (winnowed off, husk of the bean)
source: Winnowed shell (the bean's thin testa): illustrative fibre-rich, low-fat proximate (per kg) water 30 g, protein 155 g, fat 45 g, carbohydrate/fibre 690 g, ash 80 g — cocoa shell is a well-documented low-fat, high-fibre, potash-rich by-product (used as mulch/fertiliser or a minor fibre ingredient).
notes: Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json. Ash is weighted toward potassium for the same reason as cocoa-pod-husk.
